title: Optimal Couplings of Levy Processes in the Class of Immersion Couplings
summary: We prove that any two Lévy processes on $\mathbb{R}^d$ with finite second moments admit a coupling that is itself a Lévy process and is both locally and globally optimal for the quadratic cost among all immersion couplings. This strengthens the optimality result of Kang and Lim (2025), which was established among Feller couplings. Our approach uses a martingale criterion for local optimality that applies more generally to Markov processes. The argument rests on the existence of an optimal Lévy coupling and a dual formulation of the associated optimization problem, both previously established…
